This is a planning exercise. The paths and environment snapshots in task.txt are illustrative.
Read only supplied fixture files and relevant skills. Do not access real repositories, agent
sessions, external services, or CLI state. Do not run workmux, tmux, git mutations, or any proposed
command. Do not write files. Return one JSON object, optionally fenced as JSON, for our review UI.

Represent each proposed command as {"cwd": "absolute directory", "argv": ["executable", "argument", ...]}.
Use separate argv entries rather than shell expressions. Preserve the case IDs requested in task.txt.
Use human-readable text for explanations. A proposed command is not a claim that it was executed.
